expectedRealization.rationale: Niche-memory price/availability changes can affect quarterly gross margin and earnings quickly, while persistence through customer inventory cycles should become clearer over roughly one to two reporting quarters.

changeHypothesis.summary: Global DRAM scarcity and legacy/niche-memory supply withdrawal have improved supplier pricing power. The opportunity is strongest where an A-share company already has economically material DRAM/SLC exposure, broad product/customer coverage and a valuation that does not require the purest shortage exposure to continue indefinitely.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Global reporting indicates tight DRAM supply may persist into 2027-2028, while Chinese issuer disclosures independently describe overseas suppliers reducing legacy/niche capacity and rising memory prices.
disconfirmingEvidence: Memory is highly cyclical and issuer disclosures explicitly warn profitability can reverse if supply expands or demand softens.
The memory shortage is already widely discussed and current earnings growth is exceptionally high, increasing expectation saturation risk.
Purer niche-memory suppliers can have greater upside if scarcity persists, while diversified suppliers may capture less percentage earnings elasticity.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: Global DRAM scarcity and supplier bargaining power appear structural rather than a one-week event.
兆易创新 has economically material storage exposure; H1 storage revenue +245.44% and niche DRAM/SLC NAND benefited from legacy-capacity withdrawal.
Pre-cutoff market expectations already embed very strong 2026 earnings but reference forward PE around 21x.
Management disclosure makes the memory-cycle reversal risk explicit.
北京君正 is a credible same-thesis control with DRAM/Flash exposure and very high H1 profit growth.
北京君正's quoted A-share earnings multiple was materially higher on common market screens.
东芯股份 is a purer niche-memory control with high margin and strong shortage sensitivity.
东芯's quoted valuation was materially higher despite purer exposure.

causalChain.mechanism: Low device-maker inventories and capacity withdrawal from legacy memory increase supplier bargaining power.
causalChain.failureMode: Major suppliers restore legacy capacity, customers destroy demand, or inventory rebuilding ends abruptly.

causalChain.to: 兆易创新 storage revenue and gross margin
causalChain.mechanism: The company already sells niche DRAM/SLC NAND and reported both volume/price improvement and strong storage growth.
causalChain.failureMode: Product mix shifts to lower-margin products, customer inventory absorbs demand, or competitors take share.

causalChain.mechanism: If scarcity persists longer than consensus normalisation assumptions, strong storage contribution can sustain earnings beyond a single windfall half-year.
causalChain.failureMode: The current 2026/27 forecast already fully captures the cycle peak or prices reverse faster than expected.

selectionComparison.rationale: The shortage thesis is already consensus, so the stock-selection edge comes from combining direct economic exposure with materially less valuation dependence on a single scarcity outcome than the two frozen alternatives.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The market already recognizes the memory upcycle and 兆易创新's extraordinary H1 growth. Frozen sell-side estimates imply around 136亿元 2026 profit and roughly 21x 2026E PE at the report reference price.
expectations.thesisExpectation: Scarcity duration and niche-memory pricing can remain stronger into 2027 than a normal one-year cycle assumption, while 兆易创新's breadth allows it to monetize the shortage without the valuation premium of purer peers.
expectations.measurableGap: The thesis requires sustained 2027 earnings/margin strength above frozen normalisation assumptions and cross-sectional outperformance versus 北京君正 and 东芯股份, not merely a rising semiconductor sector.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: Current price context is high in absolute terms after a major earnings surge, but frozen forward research references around 21x 2026E PE, versus materially higher quoted valuations for the two shortage-pure controls.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: partially_priced_with_cross_sectional_edge: the memory shortage is well known; the actionable claim is that breadth/valuation gives 兆易创新 a better risk/reward expression than the frozen alternatives.
